_instructions: Paste wallet addresses you found yourself (Dune dashboards, KolScan, leaderboards, a trader you follow) into the "wallets" list, then restart and set SMART_MONEY_SEEDS=1 (and SMART_MONEY_COLLECTOR=1).
Each entry is either a plain base58 Solana address string, or an object: { "wallet": "<address>", "reported_pnl": 12345, "period": "30d", "label": "where you found it" }.

reported_pnl / period / label are for your audit trail only. They are NEVER trusted: every wallet is re-scored from its own on-chain trades with the holdout rule, using only trades before the scoring time.
Only public wallet addresses. Do not add addresses you merely guessed belong to a person.
Seeds are survivors (they are on a list because they already did well), so the forward test compares them with random control wallets.
At most 500 wallets are read. Invalid addresses and duplicates are ignored.
